name: fake-spreadsheet
description: Proof of concept: edit .xlsx workbooks in the browser and save them back without losing charts, pivots or formulas

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src tests e2e scripts vite.config.ts vite.lib.config.ts vite.verify.config.ts vite.glide.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.pages:dev: node scripts/build-sites.mjs demo && wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:demo && npm run deploy:portal && npm run deploy:angular
scripts.deploy:demo: node scripts/build-sites.mjs demo && wrangler pages deploy --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:portal: node scripts/build-sites.mjs portal && wrangler pages deploy --cwd sites/portal --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:angular: node scripts/build-sites.mjs angular && wrangler pages deploy --cwd sites/angular --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.build:lib: vite build -c vite.lib.config.ts --mode react && vite build -c vite.lib.config.ts --mode standalone && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json
